speaker: Patient
text: Newborn, born after the 32nd gestational week. The baby was born via cesarean delivery. The mother had gestational diabetes but was otherwise healthy with no other pregnancy-related diseases.

DIAGNOSIS READY: Respiratory Distress Syndrome (RDS) due to prematurity (born at 32 weeks).

I have noted the baby was born via C-section to a diabetic mother, which increases the risk. Can you describe the specific signs of distress you are seeing, such as nasal flaring, grunting, or chest retractions?
